readerQuestionCoverage.item: Does popping pimples cause permanent scars?
readerQuestionCoverage.whyThisMatters: Popping deep nodules ruptures the follicular wall, causing dermal collagen collapse.
readerQuestionCoverage.finalCopyUse: Explain the biomechanics of dermal tissue damage leading to rolling or boxcar scars.

readerQuestionCoverage.item: How do I stop picking my face?
readerQuestionCoverage.whyThisMatters: Behavioral habits (mirror triggers, stress) lead to compulsive picking.
readerQuestionCoverage.finalCopyUse: Suggest practical swaps like hydrocolloid pimple patches and mirror dimming tips.

recommendationSanityPlan.item: Salicylic Acid Spot Treatment / Pimple Patches
recommendationSanityPlan.whyThisMatters: Non-invasive treatments prevent picking behavior and reduce inflammation quickly.
recommendationSanityPlan.finalCopyUse: Provide clear guidelines on using hydrocolloid patches on whiteheads and salicylic/clindamycin spot gels on red nodules.

claimRiskPlan.item: Scar prevention creams can undo picking damage instantly
claimRiskPlan.whyThisMatters: Topical creams cannot rebuild deep structural voids left by picked nodules.
claimRiskPlan.finalCopyUse: Be clear that preventing damage in the first place is far more effective than trying to treat pitted scars later.

troubleshootingPlan.item: What to do if you just popped a pimple
troubleshootingPlan.whyThisMatters: Immediate wound care prevents infection and limits hyperpigmentation.
troubleshootingPlan.finalCopyUse: Provide a 3-step emergency protocol (disinfect, hydrate, occlude) to minimize scar risk.
